text: The historical change removes the nsIAbPreferMailFormat IDL constants block. The checked owned address-book paths no longer name that interface. This is an interface cleanup, not evidence that Thunderbird removed every mail-format preference or conversion behavior. No new manual syntax convention follows just from deleting the unused declaration. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Removing nsIAbPreferMailFormat retires an unused constants interface
